face_convention: N/E/S/W are the cube's side contacts with the module turned exactly as drawn in its raw_orig_icon (rotation 0). A module wider than one cell has one contact position per cell along its long edges, numbered from 1 at the left end (N1…N6, S1…S6); W and E are its two ends.
placement_convention: Every module is one cell tall; width_cells gives its width. A module can be turned in quarter steps and placed in any field cell unless it sets rotatable: false or a slot (the antenna bar only fits the antenna slot, as drawn).
connection_convention: Each entry in pinout.connections is either a two-terminal element or wire, {from, to, via}, or a multi-terminal element, {via, terminals: {terminal name: face}} (e.g. a bjt's base/collector/emitter). A polarized two-terminal element (symmetric: false) conducts from → to: a diode's anode is 'from' and its cathode 'to'; an electrolytic's + terminal is 'from'. A button's terminals are all apart when released and all joined while it is held. An inductor section may also give its winding name and turns.

elements.name: block_001
elements.notes: Confirmed as drawn, the same as block_003: W is one node and N/E/S the other, with the resistor between them, so it works straight through (W–E) or as a corner (W–N, W–S). catalogue.ts:r2k2-o has only the W–E resistor, so it is missing the N and S wires.

elements.name: block_002
elements.notes: Confirmed as drawn: a plain wire joins W and E, and the resistor runs from that node to S. catalogue.ts:r12k-a has a plain corner resistor with no W–E wire.

elements.name: block_003
elements.notes: Electrically W is one node and N/E/S are one node, with the resistor between them, so it can be used straight through (W–E) or as a corner (W–N, W–S). The small ring on a stem under the resistor body is unexplained; blocks 004, 006 and 012 have one too, so it isn't what tells the two 68 кОм modules apart; its meaning is still unknown. The kit's other 68 кОм module is block_004, drawn differently, so num_in_kit = 1.

elements.name: block_004
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 1. Second 68 кОм module (block_003 is the first). Confirmed as drawn: resistor N–E, plus an independent plain wire W–S that doesn't touch it; the small ring's meaning is unknown. catalogue.ts:r68k-a has the corner resistor but not the W–S wire.

elements.name: block_005
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 2. First of two 680 кОм modules. Confirmed as drawn: resistor W–E with plain wires W–N and E–S, so W/N is one node and E/S the other. catalogue.ts:r680k-o has only the W–E resistor.

elements.name: block_006
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 3. Second 680 кОм module. Confirmed as drawn, the same shape as block_002: a plain wire joins W and E, and the resistor runs from that node to S; the small ring's meaning is unknown. catalogue.ts:r680k-a has a plain corner resistor with no W–E wire.

elements.name: block_007
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 4. First of two 1 МОм modules. Confirmed as drawn, the same shape as block_004 without the ring: resistor N–E, plus an independent plain wire W–S. catalogue.ts:r1m-a has the corner resistor but not the W–S wire.

elements.name: block_008
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_004-008_raw_table.png, row 5. Second 1 МОм module. Confirmed as drawn: resistor W–E, plus a plain wire E–N, so W is one node and E/N the other. catalogue.ts:r1m-o has only the W–E resistor.

elements.name: block_009
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 1. First of three 0,01 мкФ modules. Confirmed as drawn, the same shape as block_003: W is one node and N/E/S the other, with the capacitor between them. catalogue.ts:c10n-o has only the W–E capacitor.

elements.name: block_010
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic tubular type KT-1, temperature group N70, 680 pF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 2. Confirmed: a W–E wire and an N–S wire cross without touching (the W–E line hops around the centre, as on «Мостик»), and the capacitor sits on the N–E chord hidden under the ink blot, so it joins the two wires: {N,S} to {W,E}. catalogue.ts:c680p-a has a plain corner capacitor with neither wire.

elements.name: block_011
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic tubular type KT-1, temperature group N70, 3300 pF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 3. Confirmed as drawn, the same shape as block_008: capacitor W–E, plus a plain wire E–N. catalogue.ts:c3n3-o has only the W–E capacitor.

elements.name: block_012
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 4. Second 0,01 мкФ module. Confirmed as drawn, the same shape as block_011: capacitor W–E, plus a plain wire E–N; the small ring's meaning is unknown. Row order maps it to catalogue.ts:c10n-a, which wrongly has a plain corner capacitor.

elements.name: block_013
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, ceramic type K10-7V, temperature group N90, 0.01 µF +80/−20%
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_009-013_raw_table.png, row 5. Third 0,01 мкФ module. Confirmed as drawn: capacitor W–E, plus a plain wire E–S. The bottom of the circle is cut off by the edge of the scan. catalogue.ts:c10n-o2 has only the W–E capacitor.

elements.name: block_014
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, aluminium electrolytic type K50-6-1, 10 V, 20 µF
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 1. No tolerance is printed. First of two 20 мкФ modules. Confirmed as drawn: electrolytic with + on W and − on E, plus a plain wire E–S, so the − side is on both E and S. catalogue.ts:c20u-o has only the W(+)–E capacitor.

elements.name: block_015
elements.eng_interpret: Capacitor, aluminium electrolytic type K50-6-1, 10 V, 20 µF
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 2. No tolerance is printed. Second 20 мкФ module. Confirmed as drawn: electrolytic with + on W and − on E, plus a plain wire E–N, so the − side is on both E and N. Row order maps it to catalogue.ts:c20u-a, which wrongly has a plain corner electrolytic.

elements.name: block_016
elements.eng_interpret: Two diodes, germanium point-contact type D9B
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 3. Two diodes in series W→S→E with the midpoint on S, so the module gives either diode alone or both in series, and a plain W–N wire makes the first anode reachable on both W and N. catalogue.ts:dd9b has the two diodes but not the W–N wire.

elements.name: block_017
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 4. First of the kit's two transistors. The plain N–E wire makes the collector reachable on both N and E. Every line in the icon is accounted for: base to W, collector up to N, emitter down to S, and the chord from the top rim to the right rim. Terminals match catalogue.ts:q315-a, but the catalogue gives that module no E contact, so it's missing the N–E wire.

elements.name: block_018
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_014-018_raw_table.png, row 5. Second transistor. Same terminal faces as block_017; the only difference is which leg also reaches E: here the emitter (S–E wire), and N–E is explicitly not connected. Every line in the icon is accounted for, including the chord from the bottom rim to the right rim. Contradicts catalogue.ts:q315-b, which has collector S and emitter N, and no E contact.

elements.name: block_019
elements.rus_orig_desc: Антенна магнитная. Сердечник 400НН-8×80 мм. Катушка L1 содержит 100+230 витков провода ПЭВ-2 0,16 мм, катушка L2 содержит 25 витков провода ПЭВ-2 0,16 мм
elements.eng_interpret: Magnetic (ferrite-rod) antenna. Core: ferrite grade 400NN, 8 × 80 mm. Coil L1: 100 + 230 turns of PEV-2 enamelled wire, 0.16 mm; coil L2: 25 turns of PEV-2 wire, 0.16 mm.
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_019-019_raw_table.png. One cell tall and six wide; fits only the antenna slot, as drawn. Confirmed: L1 starts on N2 and N5 (joined by a wire under L2), is tapped on N6 after 100 turns, and ends on E after a further 230; L2 (25 turns) runs N3–N4 and isn't wired to L1. Nothing reaches W, N1 or the S edge. No inductance is printed, and which way the windings are wound relative to each other isn't known. catalogue.ts:ant differs: it puts L1 across the W and E ends with the tap and L2 on N2 and N5, and ties L2 to L1's E end (SPEC.md §8 open question 4).

elements.name: block_020
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_020-024_raw_table.png, row 1. Confirmed as drawn: one corner link joining E and S. catalogue.ts:j-ugol has N–E, the same corner turned. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_021
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_020-024_raw_table.png, row 2. Confirmed as drawn: all four faces joined at the centre. Matches catalogue.ts:j-krest. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_022
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_020-024_raw_table.png, row 3. Confirmed: not a blank. Two separate corner links, N–W and E–S, that don't touch each other. SPEC.md and catalogue.ts:j-shchel wrongly treat it as a blank with no connections. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_023
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_020-024_raw_table.png, row 4. Confirmed as drawn: one straight link joining W and E. Matches catalogue.ts:j-liniya. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_024
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_020-024_raw_table.png, row 5. Confirmed as drawn: W, E and S joined at the centre. Matches catalogue.ts:j-troynik. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_025
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_025-026_raw_table.png, row 1. Confirmed as drawn: two separate links, W–E and N–S, that cross without touching (the N–S line humps over the W–E one). Matches catalogue.ts:j-mostik. num_in_kit from SPEC.md.

elements.name: block_026
elements.notes: OCR'd from blocks_025-026_raw_table.png, row 2. Taller than a cube, with a push cap; normally open per SPEC.md (not printed in the table). Confirmed: released, W, E and S are all apart; held, all three are joined (the inner ring in the icon is the cap, with stubs to W, E and S). catalogue.ts:sb switches only W–E, so it is missing S. The small dash below-left of the circle is a scan speck. short_id ZA wraps the letter chain past YZ.
